propositions: No aggregated lens exists to trend 344 closed bugs across close_class distribution, detection channel, age, component fan-in, and time-to-close; questions today require ad-hoc scripts
Pre-convention bugs (~214) lack close_class annotation; the lens must surface this era-skew via an explicit MISSING labeled cohort, never silently dropping or merging it
Sparse or absent detected_by field must degrade that dimension to unavailable state without crashing or affecting other dimensions

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close TRANSITION timestamp within CLI range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, fan-in, detected_by dist) ignore range and measure point-in-time store state
Empty store must return unavailable state per registry convention rather than crash or report empty-as-healthy
